title: Frame Sync sensor-side static evidence map
scope: sensor SPI/read/configuration and exclusion of Timer132 button gate; no devices, no headless, no C changes
status: partial static evidence; internal sensor frame/exposure sync unproven

timer132.gpio_route: COMPARE0 5F9B2140 -> GPPI handle byte773A -> GPIOTE130 TASKS_SET[byte773D] at5F934030+4ch -> P1.02
timer132.gpio_configuration: MODE3 task; PSEL2 PORT1; POLARITY3 for OUT task; OUTINIT0. Actual selected TASKS_SET always sets high independent of OUT polarity.
timer132.irq: 0x2302b224 on COMPARE1; six GPIOs sampled ->1502 and76D0; 2944C clears CONFIG.OUTINIT forP1.02; submitwork6764
timer132.conclusion: button-sampling-related gate; no evidence it is sensor exposure trigger
timer132.caution: OUTINIT store is proven; physical low transition latency requires hardware validation. Do not claim exact30us high pulse from software alone.

sensor_rate_profile_selection.semantic_status: configuration changes with mode/rate/DPI proven; actual sensor frame period/exposure/clock lock cannot be decoded without matching private register definitions

unknowns: No verified private sensor register map or PCB net names in this bounded evidence; register0x16 is software read command, not proof of exposure trigger.
No measured GPIO/SPI/RADIO/USB timing. Work scheduling, mutex contention and SPI polling introduce variable delay; no zero-jitter or one-frame-per-report claim.
No direct periodic hardware path to sensor reset/control P2.01 established in inspected paths; bounded result does not prove no hidden internal sensor sync mode.
Timer132 gateP1.02 is linked tobutton capture; its physical electrical load has not been proven fromPCB.
Long sensor profile tables contain decompiler omissions; JSON numerical table ledger labels values unverified until individual raw argument flow is checked.
SPI cache7745 can retain priorreg/count; successbyte7746 alone does not provefresh valid sensor data.
P2.04 input semantics beyondmotion-read gating, internal sensor frame clock and exposure phase remain unresolved.
